next.reason: Both print "The words IN and OF are equivalent": §1985:IV.4.3.8.5.3 SR1 for the qualifiers of the identifier format, §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR3 for the qualification formats that the 2023 identifier reaches through "Format 2 (qualified-data-name-with-subscripts)" (§2023:8.4.3.1.2). The same qualified names are accepted with either word. The 2023 formats that take OF alone (an object property, SUPER) are new syntax the 1985 rule never covered.
